derivation.onset: Onset (3.4, 7.5, A30, A35): the Day +5 ICE 8/10 finding falls 4.8 h after IV lorazepam (a closed-list sedating drug, in the same note) and no clinician attributes it. If it counts, onset is Day +5 and the record (Day +6) is 7.1 (+1). If excluded, the earliest unaffected finding is Day +6, equal to the record: 7.7. The readings give different categories, so 7.5, reason attribution.
derivation.max_grade: Max grade (3.4, 7.5 condition, 7.7): under both readings the highest grade is 2 (Day +6, ICE 6/10 and 5/10, awakens to voice), far from the lorazepam (31 h earlier, outside the 24 h rule A30). The Day +5 finding is only Grade 1. Both readings give 7.7, so the shared category is used, not 7.5.

ambiguity_notes: Onset is 7.5 only because the readings split between 7.1 and 7.7. The documented onset is shown as the range of the two readings (2031-05-23 to 2031-05-24); the signed difference is given per reading and not as a single value.

The Day +6 findings are not near the lorazepam: 04:00 on 05-23 to 11:00 on 05-24 is 31 h, outside the 24 h rule (A30). Age 85 is in scope (>=18). Tocilizumab, dexamethasone are treatment (A35). Tremor on Day +6 is excluded.
